cover.js: value => { var text = String(value || '').trim(); if (!text) { return null; } if (text.indexOf('http') === 0) { return text; } while (text.charAt(0) === '/') { text = text.slice(1); } return 'https://ani.girigirilove.com/' + text; }

list.js: function (value, ctx) { var info = (ctx.json && ctx.json.info) || {}; var roads = String(info.vod_play_url || '').split('$$$'); var names = String(info.vod_play_from || '').split('$$$'); var out = []; for (var r = 0; r < roads.length; r++) { var road = String(roads[r] || ''); if (!road) { continue; } var groupTitle = String(names[r] || '').trim() || ('线路 ' + (r + 1)); var episodes = road.split('#'); for (var i = 0; i < episodes.length; i++) { var parts = String(episodes[i] || '').split('$'); var url = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : ''; if (!url) { continue; } out.push({ title: (parts[0] || '').trim() || ('第 ' + (i + 1) + ' 集'), url: url, group: groupTitle, groupTitle: groupTitle, order: i + 1 }); } } return out; }
